headline: Violent Frontline Reversals Shake Weathered Expanse and Linn of Mercy
war_summary: Since our previous edition, the lull in Weathered Expanse and Linn of Mercy has shattered, with both sectors erupting into frantic base combat and logging eight structural exchanges apiece over the past two hours. In the Expanse, where three strategic points currently stand unclaimed in no-man's-land, fighting churned around Spirit Watch and Crow’s Nest right up to the wire, while Linn of Mercy witnessed rapid shifts across Outwich Ranch and Lathair even as casualty rates cooled from earlier peaks. Palantine Berm shows no letup in its bitter contest, tallying nine fresh base events and over four hundred casualties across Vendett and Windburn Landing. Further east, Godcrofts was shaken at the cutoff by the neutralization of Isawa. By contrast, base turnover paused on Stlican Shelf, while Stonecradle slowed to a single flip, though both fronts continue to absorb heavy casualties. Nevish Line similarly registered no new territorial transfers during the watch, yet sustained a brutal surge in bloodletting with nearly sixteen hundred casualties reported over the last two hours.
